lastTask: Implement Byte 15a deterministic melody scoring and repair

projectState.summary: Byte 15a builds on the approved Byte 14 song form by adding deterministic melody scoring and repair for the chorus. Players now have tiny influence phrase corpora, `src/melody-scoring.ts` scores raw and repaired chorus material for landing, monotony, and surprise-vs-target from each player's perspective, transport receives Raw/Repaired chorus material through the song-form/lookahead arrangement seam, the inspector exposes Melody Score A/B plus per-player scores and critique, and Up/Down feedback persists `song.take_feedback` records while Down rejects a phrase key and repairs again. Claude approved the substrate after the register-aware fix: repair candidates are bounded to the phrase register and leap/monotony/surprise intervals use register-aware melodic position, closing the octave-plunge bug. No model critic is in the loop yet; that remains Byte 15b-a.
